failure_summary.description: Agents reran searches or returned no-op instead of retrieving compatible cached results and applying newly supplied filters.
Agents interpreted “afternoon” as an overly broad departure window instead of the intended afternoon range.
Agents skipped actionable work, including a complete independent restaurant search or a newly specified hotel filter.
Agents inferred an unstated hotel party size or passed an unsupported qualitative descriptor as an airline.
The agent treated a two-date round trip as one outbound search rather than separate outbound and return legs.

patch.reasoning: Most failures violate cache, required-information, parameter-validation, and itinerary rules that the skill already states, so duplicating those instructions is unwarranted. The clear gap is that “afternoon” has no defined flight-time range, which led to incorrect filtering in both flight trajectories with that preference.

edits.target: Use the exact format accepted by the relevant tool for preferences such as time ranges, converting natural-language times as needed.
edits.content: For a flight departure preference described as “in the afternoon,” use `departure_time=["12:00 PM", "5:00 PM"]`.
